title.zh: 恢复课程词汇即时加载

purpose.en: Prevent the signed-in 21-day vocabulary page from remaining on its loading state while a missing adaptive-sentence cache triggers synchronous AI generation.
purpose.zh: 避免登录后的 21 天词汇页在缺少自适应句子缓存时因同步触发人工智能生成而持续停留在加载状态。

en: Load an existing adaptive-sentence cache when one is already available.
Fall back immediately to the reviewed 120-sentence course catalog when no adaptive cache exists.
zh: 已有自适应句子缓存时继续读取并使用。
没有自适应缓存时立即回退到已审核的每课程 120 句目录。

en: Signed-in Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced course vocabulary pages for all twelve learning languages.
Payment, referral, certificate, subscription, role, and provider settings are unchanged.
zh: 影响十二种学习语言中已登录用户的初期、中级和高级课程词汇页。
付款、推荐、证书、订阅、角色及服务商设置均不变。

en: Extract a reusable D1 cache lookup from the adaptive-sentence service.
Remove synchronous AI generation from the vocabulary page's initial API response while preserving cached adaptive content and the graded-catalog fallback.
Add a regression contract that rejects reintroducing blocking adaptive generation on this route.
zh: 从自适应句子服务提取可复用的 D1 缓存查询。
从词汇页首个接口响应移除同步人工智能生成，同时保留已缓存的自适应内容和分级句子目录回退。
增加回归契约，防止该路由重新引入阻塞式自适应生成。

en: Run vocabulary, adaptive-learning, 4,320-sentence catalog, typecheck, lint, full repository tests, sensitive-data scan, D1 validation, and shared site gates.
After deployment, repeat the signed-in production vocabulary step in the user's real Chrome session and continue the four-language QA acceptance.
zh: 运行词汇、自适应学习、4,320 句目录、类型检查、代码检查、完整仓库测试、敏感数据扫描、D1 验证及共享站点门禁。
部署后在用户真实 Chrome 会话中重测登录后的生产词汇步骤，并继续四语言 QA 验收。

en: Adaptive sentence generation remains available to non-blocking generation paths; an uncached vocabulary request intentionally uses reviewed course sentences.
zh: 自适应句子生成仍供非阻塞生成路径使用；未缓存的词汇请求会有意采用已审核课程句子。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's Chinese interface, twelve learning languages, server-graded progress, Clerk identity, Worker, D1, R2, course catalog, and payment resources.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 中文界面、十二种学习语言、服务端评分进度、Clerk 身份、Worker、D1、R2、课程目录及付款资源。
